written: 2026-10-26 after the London design run, BEFORE its holdout was looked at
design_result: continuation is WRONG more often than right: hit 44.9% (2,642 checks), i.e. London band breaks REVERSE before the NY open; one-sided continuation p 0.9997 -> two-sided p ~0.0007
deviation_from_declaration: the declaration tested continuation one-sided. The candidate taken to the holdout is the mirror (FADE: lean against the band side), decided after seeing design, before the holdout. Same statistic, opposite sign.
holdout_contamination: F15 (London noise-band BREAKOUT with stops/targets/costs) was already validated on 2022-now and failed (all 50 variants negative). That result leans toward a fade in 2022+, so this holdout is NOT clean evidence; live forward logging is the real test.
fade_rule: London fade bias goes live (labelled 'unproven, being tracked') only if holdout fade hit > 50% with one-sided p < 0.05 for rest-of-London. Rest-of-day (L2) not a candidate.
size_rule: Asia-range day-size forecast for London goes live if holdout corr > 0 with p < 0.05.
